text.text_excerpt: Love those buttermilk drops. and the got breakfast is pretty good. I haven't made it in for lunch yet but i hear it's pretty good.

We have made this or regular spot every Saturday morning. Breakfast rice is so good. Dave for the handlebar and Apple fritters. The cream and Jelly filled donuts are good and pretty standard but there have been two different occasions where there was hardly any filling at all and another time the cream seemed as though it was about to hit its sell by date. I did mention the possibly spoiled cream issue to the staff but didn't bother them with the lack of filling. I don't see the point in making a fuss. Staff are always very polite and friendly as well. I am going to miss this place in June when I move. I will need to try some of the lunches before then

I've come here a few times since moving to the area. I've add the buttermilk drops, which are not quite the same as McKenzie's, but amazing nonetheless. I've had their king cake, which is not quite Randazzo's, but is definitely an adequate substitute. I've had their breakfast rice, which is a decently flavored blend of breakfast yummies. And I've had one not-so-great item, the jerk ribs. I did not like the flavor on the ribs, just a bit too salty. And the potato salad had a slightly odd flavor as well. The mac-n-cheese was good tho. And the staff are super friendly.
